user.title: Connect to Controme
user.description: Connect to the Controme Mini-Server in your local network. The JSON API uses plain HTTP: the password is transmitted unencrypted, so use this only in your local network.

data_description.host: Address of the Mini-Server, e.g. 192.0.2.10 or controme.local.
data_description.username: Controme user; needed for the room details and for writing.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Choose the rooms that get additional entities (valves, return flow, offsets, next change). Rooms without control are deselected. The room climate itself comes from the official Controme integration.

system_sensors.title: System sensors
system_sensors.description: Sensors that serve no room as room or return-flow sensor, e.g. flow temperatures or hot water. Only selected sensors become entities.

gateway.title: Gateway {number}
gateway.description:
The Controme API does not name gateways, only outputs per floor. Choose the floors this gateway supplies (several floors may share one gateway) and its type.

Floors without gateway so far:
{floors}

Where to find the type in Controme: Configuration → House & devices → Gateways. If the section "Maximum opening values for outputs (FBH-PRO only)" is shown, it is a PRO gateway.

data_description.type: Which gateway supplies these floors? Automatic: valve positions count as soon as a value above 1 was reported; until then only "Heating" is available.

writes.title: Write functions
writes.description: Functions that change settings on the Controme system. All of them are off by default.

data_description.write_offset: Temporary offset per room; Home Assistant renews it every 5 minutes because Controme drops it after 10 minutes.

reauth_confirm.title: Controme credentials rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The Mini-Server at {host} rejected the credentials. Enter them again.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Mini-Server. Check the address and that it is in the same network.
error.api_disabled: The API is disabled on this Controme system. Enable it in Controme and try again.
error.no_house: No house with rooms was found on this Controme system.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Controme system is already configured.
